description: Puts a tested version live at the site's address and the person's domains (the newest one with testers, or the one named), now or at a time (at, ISO 8601). Ploa reviews it again first; anything unsafe stops it. Like production in the stores, it needs a person: this only asks, and the person approves on ploa.dev (ploa_approval_status tells you), unless ploa_access says you're autonomous, when it goes at once. Never try another way around the approval.

at.description: When it goes live (ISO 8601); default now.

site.description: The site's address (the part before .ploa.app) or ID. Needed when the workspace has more than one site.

version.description: The version's build number (13) or ID, as ploa_web_status lists them.

name: ploa_web_release
title: Release a web version
